Marissa — thanks for the context. I redlined the order form and added inline comments. High-level recommendations:

1) Invoice trigger: propose "Invoice 1: upon countersignature (Execution) for 50% of first tranche; Invoice 2: on activation (successful production enablement) for remaining 50% of first tranche; subsequent tranches invoiced per the schedule in Appendix A." This hybrid covers Finance and Product. I added the exact clause: "First invoice shall be issued upon countersignature of this Order Form; the second invoice for the initial tranche shall be due upon Customer activation of the Service as defined in Appendix B."

2) Net terms: propose Net 45 from invoice date to align with Acme's standard. I added a negotiated exception in the order form: "Net 45 for all invoices unless otherwise agreed in writing. Failure to pay may trigger service hold per Section 7."

3) Taxes/withholding: add a short tax residency paragraph: "Customer shall be responsible for any applicable withholding taxes. Redwood shall provide, upon Customer request, documentation of Redwood's tax residency (e.g., W-9 or residency certificate) to support any reduced withholding. Where Customer is required to withhold, Customer shall provide evidence of payment to Redwood within thirty (30) days of withholding." I also attached Acme_Tax_Certificate.pdf for their records.

4) Attachment & flow: I included a final invoice schedule table in the redline (see attachment: Proposed_Invoice_Schedule.xlsx — updated). Please note legal flagged potential ambiguity around the term "activation" and recommended referencing Appendix B for the exact activation checklist.

Marissa — if you can confirm Acme is flexible on 50/50 split of the first tranche, I'll upload the redline to DocuSign and send for countersignature.

Kimberly Park
